Folks — reviewed the updates and ran the adjusted run-rate table. High-level: moving DEAL-43822 out of Q2 commit reduces forecasted ARR by $220k; keeping DEAL-43821 at 70% keeps $410k as a probabilistic entry.

I accepted provisional numbers with the following assumptions (documented in the Drive):
- Best: both deals close as-is = +$630k ARR
- Likely: DEAL-43821 at 70% = +$287k ARR (DEAL-43822 excluded)
- Worst: neither closes = +$0 ARR

Finance will use the Likely scenario in the mid-month forecast unless you provide a hard commit (owner email + procurement confirmation) by EOD tomorrow 04/23. Also: please ensure the CRM close dates match the last communicated client expected date — we’ll reconcile any differences in the weekly FP&A sync.

Thanks for the quick turn. I pulled the refreshed coverage_rollup from Ben’s export and attached an annotated sheet.
